title: Nineteen Eighty-Fortnite - #FreeFortnite
summary: A one-minute Fortnite parody of Apple's 1984 ad, released when Epic Games challenged the App Store and Apple removed Fortnite from iOS. It frames Apple as the monopolist.
why: HN cites it as a famous piece of anti-Apple marketing, with some praising the ad and others mocking the spin.

quote.text: Apple has now turned into what they despised.
